contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ AETHELRED REX ANGLO[X] ; R/ OSVLFMOGYPESWIC

A damaged silver penny of Æthelred II of Northumbria. Mint or issue place: Ipswich. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: AETHELRED REX ANGLO[X]. Reverse description: Hand of Providence issuing from clouds, AW at side. Reverse inscription: OSVLFMOGYPESWIC. Initial mark: Cross pattee
